mods.name: Unbreakable Leads
mods.description: Keeps leashed entities attached through extreme movement, chunk loading, and safe same-dimension teleports.

releases.notes:
Unbreakable Leads 1.1.2 fixes the Fabric API dependency restriction in 1.1.1.

## Fabric fix

Version 1.1.1 rejected Minecraft 26.3 instances running Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3 because it required 0.165.2 or newer. Version 1.1.2 lowers the minimum to 0.165.0 and is built and smoke-tested against that exact 26.3 API version.

Replace the old Unbreakable Leads jar with `unbreakable-leads-26.3-1.1.2.jar` in `mods/`. Keep only one Unbreakable Leads jar installed. Existing configuration is preserved.

Requirements: Minecraft 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, and Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3 or a newer API build for Minecraft 26.3.

## Paper

The separate `unbreakable-leads-paper-26.3-1.1.2.jar` goes in `plugins/`. Paper behavior is unchanged; it does not use Fabric API. It targets Paper 26.3 build 240 and Java 25.

## Validation

- Four configuration tests pass.
- A dedicated Fabric 26.3 server with Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3 loads all six Mixins and reaches the ready state.
- Both editions shut down cleanly after server startup.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` provides checksums for both release jars.

mods.name: Unbreakable Leads
mods.description: Keeps leashed entities attached through extreme movement, chunk loading, and safe same-dimension teleports.

releases.notes:
Unbreakable Leads 1.1.1 adds the Fabric edition for Minecraft 26.3 and refreshes the separate Paper plugin.

## Choose your jar

| Edition | File | Installation | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fabric | `unbreakable-leads-26.3-1.1.1.jar` | `mods/` | Minecraft 26.3, Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API 0.165.2+26.3 or a newer 26.3 build |
| Paper | `unbreakable-leads-paper-26.3-1.1.1.jar` | `plugins/` | Paper 26.3, Java 25; built and verified against build 240 |

For single-player, use the Fabric edition. Dedicated servers only need their matching server jar; players do not need to install Unbreakable Leads to join. Install one edition per instance.

Existing configuration files are preserved. Older Minecraft versions require the version-specific jars from earlier releases.

## Changes and validation

- Ports the main Fabric release from Minecraft 26.2 to 26.3.
- Rebuilds the Paper plugin against Paper 26.3 build 240.
- Updates the Gradle wrapper and project metadata and adds automated builds/releases.
- All four configuration tests pass. A dedicated Fabric server loads all six Mixins; both Fabric and Paper reach the ready state and stop cleanly.

Server smoke checks verify loading and startup, not every gameplay scenario. Cross-dimension lead preservation is not supported. See the README for the configuration and manual gameplay checklist.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for both jars.

Server-only Paper plugin for Minecraft 26.3, compiled against Paper API 26.3 build 231 stable with Java 25. Put this JAR in plugins/, not mods/. Verified on a real Paper 26.3-231 server through enable, Done, and clean shutdown.

releases.notes:
## Unbreakable Leads 1.0.0 for Minecraft 1.21.11

Compatibility JAR for the legacy Yarn-mapped 1.21.11 API.

- Protects player-held and fence-knot leads from distance snapping.
- Covers elytra firework boosts and mob mounting.
- Server-authoritative and compatible with vanilla clients.

This JAR is separate from the 26.2 release and must not be installed alongside it. See `compat-1.21.11/README.md` for API-era limitations.

releases.notes:
## Unbreakable Leads 1.0.0

Initial Minecraft 26.2 Fabric release.

- Protects player-held and fence-knot leads from automatic distance and movement snaps.
- Covers elytra firework boosts and mob mounting.
- Preserves delayed UUID and fence-knot attachments through chunk reloads and restarts.
- Adds same-dimension safe teleport catch-up.
- Includes validated server configuration and dedicated-server support.

See the README for installation, configuration, compatibility, limitations, and the manual test matrix.
